subject: Television & Streaming
title: International Content Goes Global
description: A fast breakdown of International Content Goes Global for builders.

hook.text: Squid Game was a Korean show that became the most-watched series in Netflix history. Nobody saw it coming.

buildup.text: Before streaming, foreign-language shows rarely crossed borders. Subtitles were considered a deal-breaker.

discovery.text: Netflix invested in local content worldwide—Korean thrillers, Spanish heists, German sci-fi—and gave them global reach.

twist.text: Money Heist, Dark, and Lupin proved that great storytelling transcends language. Audiences adapted to subtitles.

climax.text: Streaming democratized entertainment. A show from Seoul could outperform a Hollywood blockbuster worldwide.

punchline.text: Subtitles stopped being a barrier and became a bridge.

quiz.question: Which show became the most-watched series in Netflix history?
